derivation.behavior: Header admission blocks CRLF injection and transport-owned header abuse.
derivation.canonical_behavior: Go validates header names/values and reserves transport-owned fields before network execution.

invariants: CR/LF header injection is rejected before transport.
Host, Content-Length and connection-framing headers are transport-owned.
Authorization, Cookie, Proxy-Authorization and API-key-like values must use credential references rather than persisted raw headers.
